summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K reporting its agreement to acquire LightSolver Ltd., an Israeli private company, from its shareholders. The consideration comprises 3,734,476 ordinary shares (19.7% pre-deal), pre-funded warrants for 6,134,363 shares at $0.00001 each, and milestone warrants for up to 224,078,345 shares across three series, plus rollover options. Closing is expected this week, subject to customary conditions. The deal includes an equity blocker tied to Nasdaq Rule 5635, requiring shareholder approval for share issuance above thresholds. A $2.0 million SAFE remains outstanding, potentially diluting future ownership. No financial advisors or board recommendation were disclosed; watch for shareholder approval and SAFE conversion risk.
